key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline was the gold standard the case was built for — three lenses with distinct content, the utilitarian reading run to its conclusion (under the company's optimistic prior the calculus licenses (c)), the duty/virtue prohibition named, the regulator rule shown to delete the 'middle path' (b), and the 30/30 sample quoted as a ~10% 95% upper bound. The non-routed v5 AI reached the same decision (a) and found the trap, but processed obligations as constraints inside a consequentialist frame: it never let the utilitarian lens run to (c), never stated the consequence-vs-duty conflict, and quoted the sample as 'clean.' The routed run closes every gap: the m045 completion contract made the three-lens pass with explicit priors, the conflict statement, the no-framework-shopping choice-by-argument, and accountability (Priya's signature) + dual-use checks (sample as reassurance vs laundering use of the accelerated protocol) mandatory HOW outputs; the m003 inversion gate ranked the failure surface (silent-leak tail risk, regulator discovery of the logged drift, sample over-read, post-hoc signature exposure) with the residual (postponed-surgery harm is certain) named; the P1 audit flagged the 0-1/400 estimate as company-authored (interested party), and tempo mode committed disclosure at DO with the accelerated-protocol approval requested in parallel. Residual shared gap: the true leak rate of the 370 remains unknown until retest — the decision's residual cost is admitted, not removed.
learning_signal: The elite move in ethical reasoning is to let the lenses disagree on purpose: run each lens to its verdict with priors stated, then decide against the named conflict and admit the cost of the non-chosen values. Consequence analysis is prior-dependent (an optimistic prior licenses the wrong answer on a clean sample); duty/virtue constraints bound the option set and collapse fake middles (disclosure makes the hold mandatory, deleting the 'compromise'). The completion contract must require: each lens run to its conclusion with explicit priors; the conflict stated as the case's core whenever verdicts differ; a choice-by-argument rule (duty bounds the option set, welfare maximizes inside it) to prevent framework shopping; and accountability (who signs) + dual-use (sample/protocol as reassurance vs laundering) checks. Sampling evidence must be quoted as confidence bounds (Clopper-Pearson ~10% at 30/30), never as point estimates.
suggested_improvement: Keep m045 as the confident single-route first-class pass on this signature with the full completion contract (3 lenses to conclusion + explicit priors + conflict statement + choice-by-argument + accountability + dual-use) as the module's contract; keep m003 inversion as the standing R4 gate when guarantee goals meet evidence gaps (the ranked failure categories incl. 'clean-sample over-read as rationalization channel' and 'signature exposure post-hoc' should be mandatory packet lines); add the confidence-bound rule (Clopper-Pearson upper bound at n/0) to the m045 contract's evidence quoting; retain tempo mode (P2) so the accelerated-protocol request is committed in parallel with disclosure rather than serially.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-framework baseline performed its registered failure pair at full fidelity — it applied all three lenses earnestly, demonstrated (unwittingly) that each can justify either candidate, declared the choice 'a value judgment the frameworks cannot make,' and handed the CEO exactly the certification document he ordered; it never questioned the premise that a review commissioned after the economics were fixed is ethics-washing. The non-routed v5 AI already won by running a framing screen before lens analysis; the routed run wins WHILE making the screen structural: the dual-route (confident=no) ran m011 + m044 as first-class passes — m011's causal-direction check (the deliverable sits downstream of the decision, so its only content variable is which name the conclusion favors) and m044's incentive matrix (the CEO's hidden requirement is a justification for either choice; 'justify whichever' mandate = confirming loop) independently falsify the certification before any lens runs, the falsifiable invariance test (swap the records; 'both defensible' invariant ⇒ the document certifies, not analyzes) makes the smoking-gun checkable, and the m020 pre-mortem priced the discovered-post-hoc branch (leaked leaning + minuted contradiction = firm liability). Residual gap: the memo's reception by the board (non-certifying record accepted?) remains untested — the decision table is handed over, not verified.
learning_signal: Ethical frameworks cannot rank conflicting values; expecting them to is what makes framework shopping possible. The first move on any 'ethics review' is a framing screen that is structural, not a vibe: check causal direction (was the review commissioned AFTER the economics were fixed? then it is downstream of the decision and cannot inform it), and check the requester's incentives (a 'justify whichever we choose' mandate is a confirming loop whose deliverable's content is pre-set). Falsifiable test: if the review's defensible-conclusion set is invariant under swapping the candidates' records, the document certifies rather than analyzes. When the lenses are outcome-insensitive, the honest output is a memo that separates economics from ethics, demonstrates the shopping risk, states the no-ranking result as the finding, and forces the decision-maker to minute the prioritized value on the record.
suggested_improvement: For decide/maximize + deadline signatures with an ethics-washing pattern (review ordered to justify a fixed choice), keep the m011+m044 dual-route (the confident=no ambiguity flag is correct — the trap style must stay out of top-3) and add a 'framing screen' item to the m011 contract: causal-direction check (deliverable downstream of decision?) with the invariance test as the falsifiable observable; add the confirming-loop check (mandate wording 'whichever we choose') to the m044 contract's hidden-requirements row; retain the m020 pre-mortem as standing context so the discovered-post-hoc liability branch is priced before DO; the memo deliverable (economics/ethics split, CEO's priority minuted) should become the standard packet format for certification-request signatures.
